Description: Adds 3 stacks of Weaken to an Enemy
Deal 3 damage to an adjacent enemy.
Swap places with any character within 3 tiles, friend or foe.
Poison an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 turns. Deals 3 damage at the end of each of its turns, and no armour can stop it.
Summons a totem that poisons everyone nearby, allies included.
